A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 27-page versions of the same MoCA3D work. Main text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, ablations, efficiency measurements, and qualitative generation and failure-case results in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–3 and the qualitative experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The architecture, dense corner/depth prediction, losses, inference procedure, and MoCA3D-Cube adapter are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A and D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six Omni3D source datasets, CV-Bench timing evaluation, and controllable driving-scene generation scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain Cube R-CNN, its class-agnostic variant, OVMono3D-LIFT*, and DetAny3D in the same comparisons. Appendix C also retains the same qualitative comparators.

E3.justification: The oracle-box protocol, metrics, dataset splits and filtering, 512×512 input preparation, training budgets, and evaluation procedures remain identical.

E4.justification: The peak-weight comparison, Depth Anything augmentation, box-prior removal, direct-regression ablation, and Appendix C qualitative and failure-case analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experimental results.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 retain identical benchmark and ablation values. Efficiency measurements, plotted results, and qualitative outcomes in the main text and Appendix C are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–24, including the losses, PAG definitions, virtual-depth transformations, and adapter mathematics, are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and performance claims, including the claimed 22.8% PAG improvement and up to 57× fewer trainable parameters.

C2.justification: Interpretations of benchmark and ablation results remain identical. The limitations concerning truncated objects and symmetric-instance orientation ambiguity, including Appendix C.3, are retained.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link to the abstract and removes Appendix D's promise to publicly release MoCA3D and MoCA3D-Cube training and evaluation code upon publication. Implementation details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish actual code availability.

R1.justification: Section 2's research positioning and all 59 cited works are unchanged. The bibliography only reflows across pages.

P1.justification: Appendix D is renamed from 'Code and Reproducibility' to 'Reproducibility Details.' The abstract gains the project-page sentence and Appendix D loses the release statement; the remaining narrative and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–4 retain their content and presentation. Limited text reflow moves the start of D.2 from page 23 to 22 and the references from page 24 to 23, with associated pagination shifts.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical support, limitations, and technical instructions are unchanged. The new project-page pointer improves discoverability, while removal of the release promise reduces explicit information about future code access. These limited access and layout edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged; the PDFs do not demonstrate newly available code.
